content: Glassmorphism best practices: 4 ingredients (translucent fill rgba 0.06-0.24, backdrop blur 8-16px sweet spot, 1px light border rgba 0.15-0.25, soft shadow). Needs colorful/textured background. Limit to 3-4 glass elements per viewport for performance. Never animate backdrop-filter (animate opacity/transform instead). WCAG contrast testing critical. Use @supports fallback. Dark mode: increase white alpha, reduce blur, add brightness(1.1). Design tokens for theming. Don't use on dense text/forms. Respect prefers-reduced-transparency.
